messages:
ethan: Heads up — staging publish failed for build 2026-03-20_22:16. deploy-bot reported missing blob metadata for layer 2a7f...9c33.

deploy-bot: publish halted: blob head request 404 (s3://redwood-builds/staging/2026-03-20/2a7f9c33.tar). Rule: blob-ttl-expired. See https://internal.builds.redwood/s3/2a7f9c33

raj: ugh. Is this the same S3 key that garbage collection pruned?

ethan: looks like the object exists but HEAD returns 404 from the CDN origin during the publish job. Suspect TTL/replication expiry between regions. Logs: `HTTP/1.1 404 NoSuchKey` then `manifest publish aborted`.

lisa: we have a change window at 00:00 UTC. Can we hold the canary and pin previous digest for the staging tag until we resolve?

maria: +1 for pinning. How long to repush the layer if we rebuild? We need rollback criteria defined in case prod rollout is affected.

ethan: rebuild + reupload will take ~12–15m (CI + blob upload). But if GC picked up an orphaned blob, we need to coordinate with infra to avoid immediate re-GC.

raj: For short-term: pin staging -> previous digest (sha256:9f4b2a...). That keeps current consumers stable. Then schedule a republish in the change window and notify security/compliance for attestation re-sign.

deploy-bot: action required: tag pin requested. `deploy-bot canary-hold staging` queued by raj. Reply with `approve` to proceed.

lisa: approve. Also update release notes: "staging: pinned to previous digest due to expired blob; republish scheduled in change window."

oncall-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0421 — staging publish blocked by expired blob. Pager oncall if republish fails after window.

maria: can we add one-off exemption to GC for key prefix `staging/2026-03-20`? I can coordinate with eng-infra. Otherwise reupload might be deleted again.

ethan: yes please. @eng-infra can we hold GC for that prefix until republish completes? If not, we'll retag to previous digest and reupload under a new timestamped path.

raj: fallback plan: retag previous digest to new tag `staging-temp-1748765432` and move forward with tests. If republish succeeds, we rotate tag to canonical staging and revoke temp tag.

deploy-bot: note: when rotating tags we must re-run provenance signing. Add `--re-sign` to publish step.

lisa: ok timeline: (1) pin staging to previous digest — immediate. (2) eng-infra GC hold request — ethan to send request now. (3) republish during 00:00 UTC change window, with `--re-sign`. (4) verify canary, then rotate tag.

ethan: sending GC hold request to eng-infra. command I ran locally for diag: 
```
aws s3api head-object --bucket redwood-builds --key staging/2026-03-20/2a7f9c33.tar
# got 404 from origin, object inaccessible via CDN; origin shows object meta present in another region
```

maria: I'll contact security for a quick attestation re-run; expect ~10m after republish.

raj: leave release notes update to me and lisa. Also add a small blurb to the deploybot release summary so platform teams see the pin.

ethan: done — GC hold ticket created (INFRA-5123). Pin applied. Will post back when republish starts.

deploy-bot: deploy summary updated: staging pinned -> sha256:9f4b2a...; pending republish/attestation.

lisa: thanks everyone. If republish fails in the change window, we'll roll forward to a manual retag rollback plan and open a postmortem.

maria: noted. I'll be on standby for attestation.

ethan: updating thread when republish kicks off.
